Scarlet costume.

lines.text: Follow the flow of the breeze, the cloud, and thy heart.
Fancy some spirits? It makes for fine bedfellows with the moonlight and the breeze.
Be they current foe, or past woes, my blade shall rend them all asunder.

There's naught more pleasurable than imbibing spirits with a kind soul.
... *hic*.

Should you come to earth, call on me anytime.
Wherever my feet shall trod, I will definitely visit you.

My Lord, I've found some most valuable wine.
Shall we have a cup in the near future?
Any marvelous wine?
A more barren wasteland have I never laid my eyes upon.
My Lord, farm land is what we are in most dire need of here.
I would rather soon part from here, for there is no moon nor breeze for mine eyes to cherish.
Beware, simply brandishing a blade does not make you its master.
Surely iron cannot be forged without fire? Most peculiar indeed.
Doth my blade spring from its sheathe with greater swiftness than before?
I feel more stout than before, to a degree akin to treachery!
From you, my Lord, such deportment is most unexpected.
This... is truly an embarrassment of riches.
In the future, the two of us shall partake in the imbibing of spirits.
To wile away one's days on the surface, is this not something you have pondered?

Latterly, I've been waiting to have a drink with you, my heart full of expectancy.
Such delight goes beyond my furthest imaginations.
You manage to delight this soul of mine time and time again.
Who shall be the next to fall under my blade?
Standing by.
Here I go.
Rout them in their entirety, yes?
My blade shall not be made light of.
Which of you scornful dunderheads dare step forward?
They are as candles, the better burnt out.
The hour of retribution draws near.
You are out of harm's way, fleeting as it may be.
You must persevere!
The onus lies with me now.
Behold my ultimate blade.
Show them no quarter!
'Tis but a lark.
How's this?
Bisect.
Ow!
Ugh!
Ouch!
I was careless. No, I require more practice.
Fancy a drink?
'Tis most awkward when thine eyes doth linger on me so.

This garb doth hinder not my movement in the least.
Most comfortable, forsooth.

This garb was wrought for dancing with blades.
A fine make, verily.
Should I partake in spirits whilst garbed thus, I shall appear every bit the comely, modern young lass.

I desire to show this unto Snow White and Rapunzel,
merely to behold the look upon their fair faces.
Were I to perambulate throughout the Ark thus, none would take heed of me.
Feel free to dawdle. I shall imbibe alone for the present.
To imbibe alone doth not excite me. I shall await my Lord's arrival.

Let us make our way to the tavern in our current guise.
The experience shall be most unique, verily.

Take me to the waterfall.
I have long yearned to cleave through the waters.
Doth this not make me seem akin to a city maiden?

New spirits with a new unit... 
'Tis but a phrase I'm mulling over to commemorate these new outfits.

I feel the urge to move my body.
Wouldst thou join me?

Each time mine skill doth improve, I feel a stir within me.
Perchance 'tis but simple ambition... or at least, I hope.

Fleetly Fading hath been sharpened yet further.
Now, wouldst thou fain behold who shall bear the brunt of this blade?

Ah, thou dost present me with something most precious.
I shall accept it with gratitude, truly.
I shall repay this favor with drinks anon.
I am most thankful. When time doth permit, I shall bring thee victuals aplenty.
If thou art at leisure, wouldst thou be inclined to join me for a tipple?
My Lord, thou ought to show more restraint with thy smile.

Wouldst thou care to join me in rusticating?
I yearn to feel the wind upon my face.
Good fortune, 'tis. I was yearning for some movement.
There thou art.
Excellent. Let us proceed forthwith.
Let us go cleave them.
I feel as though mine blade could cleave the very stars.
Keep thy eyes wide open.
The sword and mind must operate as one.
It seemeth that thy blade hath dulled.
Wait but a tick, I shall finish anon.
I shall rest for a brief spell.
Let us make haste.
A clean division... or thereabouts.
Maidens, lend me thy strength.
My blade cleft well.
Begone.
'Tis been severed.
Argh...!
Ugh...!
Egads!
Mine excitement got the best of me, perchance. I beseech thee, handle the rest.
Mine body feels light, and my blade doth dance.
